newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.AFRICA WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICA WIN TOSS, PUT AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and put Australia in to bat in the first game of their seven-match one-day international series on Saturday.
South Africa: Adam Bacher, Herschelle Gibbs, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Dave Richardson, Allan Donald.
Australia: Mark Taylor (captain), Michael DiVenuto, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Adam Gilchrist, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Adam Dale, Jason Gillespie.
